rules.message: One-shot expect(await locator.isVisible()) bypasses Playwright auto-retry and races async hydration; use await expect(locator).toBeVisible() or toBeHidden() (retrieve playwright-anti-flake-and-live-probing).
keepWhen: Assertion intentionally inspects synchronous instantaneous visibility at a frozen page.clock tick after a deterministic DOM barrier has already resolved.
dropWhen: Call invokes a non-Playwright domain method named isVisible(), or appears inside a string literal, comment, or scanner fixture.

rules.message: Hardcoded waitForTimeout() slows suites and flakes under CI load; await web-first locator assertions or page.waitForResponse() instead (retrieve playwright-anti-flake-and-live-probing).
keepWhen: Spec intentionally measures a real wall-clock debounce, throttle, or CSS transition window that page.clock fake timers cannot advance.
dropWhen: Occurrence sits inside a code comment, documentation string, or scanner unit test fixture.
